verdict.rationale: The docs describe a `/plugins` plugin browser in Codex CLI and a Plugins tab for browsing and installing. They also describe one universal public plugin directory, discoverable across ChatGPT and Codex, plus curated skills installable via `$skill-installer`. A runtime probe confirmed a public, keylessly fetchable JSON catalog ('Codex official') listing plugins with categories and install policies. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of search or filtering within the browser, and independent hands-on corroboration of the in-app browsing UI itself.
